evidence_timeline.summary: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS25gfe (AT2025nzi) in galaxy NGC 4615 at magnitude m_c = 19.02 +/- 0.15. At a distance of 65 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD = 60844.31 (2025-06-18.31) with an absolute magnitude of M = -15.1 +/- 0.2. The last non-detection through forced photometry was on MJD = 60841.32. Forced photometry indicates that the transient is rising. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.
